Subject: 1:1 to discuss recent performance and support

Hi Alex,

I’d like to schedule a 45-minute 1:1 to discuss some concerns about recent work and to figure out how I can support you. I don’t want to blindside you — this meeting will be about recent performance and next steps.

Over the last quarter I’ve noticed a few specific issues:
- Persona V3 integration was due March 15 and shipped March 28 (13 days late).
- The evaluation pipeline due April 1 is still incomplete.
- Several teammates have said your code reviews have become very brief (e.g., one-line “LGTM” on complex PRs).
- You missed two team standups without notice and were unresponsive on Teams for 3+ hours on multiple occasions.

I want to be clear: I know you were a top performer last year — you led the Persona V2 launch, mentored two junior engineers, and received an “Exceeds” rating. Because of that track record, I want to understand what changed and help you get back to that level. This is a conversation to understand and support you, not a disciplinary meeting.

In the 1:1 I’d like to hear your perspective on the items above, any obstacles (workload, blockers, personal), what support you need, and to agree on concrete expectations and a short plan with measurable commitments and a two-week check-in.

Can you do 45 minutes on Tuesday at 2:00pm or Wednesday at 11:00am? If neither works, please propose two times. If now is not a good time for a performance discussion, tell me and we’ll reschedule.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
Engineering Manager
